verdict.rationale: No native bulk-operation feature appears anywhere in the evidence. The v0 Platform API and SDK claim programmatic access to all of v0's chat, project and deployment capabilities, so a user could script loops over many items, but that is a self-built workaround rather than a bulk feature. Missing for 10: a native multi-select or batch-action capability, any documented bulk API endpoints, examples of batch workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
